name: Nha Trang food guide
summary: Nem nướng is the grilled pork roll from Ninh Hòa, sweet, fatty, sour, tart, and crisp in one bite. Bún cá is the fish bowl for morning and evening, and bánh căn is the dry clay-mold cake with squid, shrimp, or egg. The night market behind 46 Trần Phú, Chợ Xóm Mới, and Chợ Đầm carry the rest.
body: Start with the Ninh Hòa pair and the clay-mold cake. Nem nướng is grilled pork, charred at the edge and soft inside, rolled with herbs and a yellow-orange sauce. Bún cá is a fish bowl in a broth of fish bone, pineapple, and tomato. Bánh căn is rice poured thin into a clay mold with no oil, topped with squid, shrimp, or egg, at the night market behind 46 Trần Phú and along Tháp Bà in the late afternoon.

The walking street behind 46 Trần Phú sells bún chả, chả cá, bánh căn, fried squid, breaded shrimp, ice cream, and six sweet bowls: pomelo chè, sương sa hạt lựu, ginseng chè, green-bean chè, glutinous rice balls in syrup, and lotus-seed chè. Chợ Xóm Mới, at 49 Ngô Gia Tự, has bánh canh chả cá, bánh xèo, bún sứa, nem nướng, bún chả cá, bún cá, and bún canh, plus a dried counter of mực một nắng, mực rim, cá khô, and cua rang muối.

Chợ Đầm has bún cá, bún chả cá, nem, bánh tráng, muối ớt xanh, and mắm. Yến sào is the swiftlet nest from Hòn Nội, also called Yến Island. The Khánh Hòa list adds nem chua with nem nướng, vịt lội Ninh Hòa, tôm hùm Bình Ba, nai khô Diên Khánh, cá tràu Võ Cạnh, sò huyết Thủy Triều, bánh ướt Diên Khánh, lẩu mực Đại Lãnh, bánh canh hẹ Vạn Giã, gỏi cá mai, bánh canh cá dầm, bánh tráng xoài Cam Lâm, and bún mực Vạn Ninh. Bún lá cá dầm Ninh Hòa and bánh canh chả cá Ninh Hòa stay the bowls already named.
specialtiesLead: Nem nướng, bún cá Ninh Hòa, and bánh căn come first, then the night-market stalls, the six sweet bowls, the Chợ Xóm Mới bowls, yến sào, the Khánh Hòa dishes, and the dried counters at Chợ Xóm Mới and Chợ Đầm.
seoTitle: Nha Trang food — nem nướng, bún cá, bún sứa, and the markets
seoDescription: Nha Trang specialties: nem nướng, bún cá, bánh căn, bún sứa, gỏi cá mai, and the market counters at Chợ Xóm Mới and Chợ Đầm.

sections.heading: Specialties
paragraphs: Nem nướng is the grilled pork roll from Ninh Hòa. Bún cá is the fish bowl for morning and evening. Bánh căn is the dry clay-mold cake, with squid, shrimp, or egg.

On the walking street behind 46 Trần Phú: bún chả, chả cá, bánh căn, fried squid, breaded shrimp, ice cream, pomelo chè, sương sa hạt lựu, ginseng chè, green-bean chè, glutinous rice balls in syrup, and lotus-seed chè.

Chợ Xóm Mới, 49 Ngô Gia Tự, serves bánh canh chả cá, bánh xèo, bún sứa, nem nướng, bún chả cá, bún cá, bún canh, chè, and bánh. Chợ Đầm serves bún cá, bún chả cá, and nem, and sells bánh tráng, muối ớt xanh, and mắm. Yến sào is the nest from Hòn Nội, also called Yến Island.

The Khánh Hòa list includes nem chua with nem nướng, vịt lội Ninh Hòa, tôm hùm Bình Ba, nai khô Diên Khánh, cá tràu Võ Cạnh, sò huyết Thủy Triều, bánh ướt Diên Khánh, lẩu mực Đại Lãnh, bánh canh hẹ Vạn Giã, gỏi cá mai Nha Trang, bánh canh cá dầm Nha Trang, bánh tráng xoài Cam Lâm, and bún mực Vạn Ninh. The dried counter at Chợ Xóm Mới adds mực một nắng, mực rim, cá khô, and cua rang muối.

spots.name: Nem nướng
spots.note: Grilled pork paste from Ninh Hòa, charred at the edge and soft inside, rolled in bánh tráng phơi sương with herbs, pickles, and fried ram. The yellow-orange sauce is sweet, fatty, sour, tart, and crisp in one bite.

spots.name: Bún cá Ninh Hòa
spots.note: A Ninh Hòa fish bowl for morning and evening, broth of fish bone with pineapple and tomato, herbs, bean sprouts, and banana blossom. One account pulls cá thu, cá ngừ, and cá cờ; the caption pulls cá bò and cá ngừ, and the cake is cá đỏ, cá nhồng, and cá thu ảo.

spots.name: Bánh căn
spots.note: A dry clay-mold rice cake with a light char, topped with a quail egg, fresh squid, or a whole shrimp, crisp and sweet with a rich xíu mại. Dip it in sweet-sour fish sauce, mắm nêm, or salty-sweet nước mắm cá kho, or in sweet-sour fish sauce with nước cá kho tót and scallion oil.

spots.name: Bún sứa
spots.note: A jellyfish noodle bowl for morning or afternoon. The broth is bone of cá thu, cá cờ, or cá liệt with ripe tomato, light, sour, clean, and sweet, and a breakfast account uses cá cờ bone and cá dầm; the bowl is crisp jellyfish, fish cake, and herbs, with mắm tôm or mắm ruốc and lime.

spots.name: Yến sào
spots.note: Swiftlet nests from Hòn Nội, also called Yến Island, served as dishes at the island restaurant. People take home raw nests, cleaned nests, and nest drinks, including Sanest.

spots.name: Nem chua Ninh Hòa
spots.note: Nem chua Ninh Hòa is named beside nem nướng. The Ninh Hòa nem is lean pork pounded and wrapped in lá chùm ruột, sour and sweet, then garlic and a dip both sweet and hot, told for the pair.

spots.note: Bánh tráng is the rice-paper specialty at Chợ Đầm, and the nem roll uses the dew-dried sheets, bánh tráng phơi sương.

sections.heading: Fine dining
paragraphs: Ember Steakhouse is the cao cấp steak room at 16A Trần Phú. The plates named there belong to that room.

spots.name: Ember Steakhouse
spots.note: A cao cấp steak room at 16A Trần Phú, phone 0398 537 968. Plates: Ember Signature Tomahawk, Dry-Aged Ribeye, Wagyu Striploin, Surf & Turf Nha Trang, Fire Kissed Oyster, Seafood Grill Platter, and Truffle Mashed Potato. Wine is on the list.

sections.heading: Themed dining
paragraphs: Sailing Club sits on the Trần Phú beach. Skylight is on the 43rd floor of Havana Hotel. Champa 76 is coffee at sunset in the craft village. At Vinpearl Harbour, Sunset Bar, Li’a Cuisine & Mixology Bar, Kasan Beer, and Warning Zone are the night rooms.
